brief:
Jared Kushner, US President Donald Trump's son-in-law and diplomatic envoy, said Israel is on track to become a "global pariah" over its genocide in the Gaza Strip, according to Middle East Eye. Kushner made the comments in an interview as his Board of Peace initiative stalls.

The statement marks a rare public criticism of Israeli policy from a figure close to the Trump administration, which has largely backed Israel's military campaign in Gaza.

title: Kushner warns Israel risks becoming global pariah over Gaza genocide
